Messages.Author: alek

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Find a Mate
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Auspex/Celerity/Necromancy
+1 stealth action. Requires an anarch.
[aus] Move the top card from your crypt to your uncontrolled region, and put this card on it if it is a non-titled vampire. This vampire is anarch.
[cel] Recruit or employ an ally or retainer from your hand and untap this acting anarch.
[nec] Recruit or employ a wraith or zombie from your hand, and its cost is reduced by 1 blood or pool.

I added "+1 stealth action" because recruiting or employing at 0 stealth is not worth the benefit of the card.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
